ja291:1.1: Sabbakāmadadaṃ kumbhaṃ kuṭaṃ laddhāna dhuttako yāva so anupāleti tāva so sukham edhati.
ja291:2.1: Yadā matto ca ditto ca pamādā kumbham abbhidā tadā naggo ca pottho ca pacchā bālo vihaññati.
ja291:3.1: Evam eva yo dhanaṃ laddhā amatto paribhuñjati pacchā tappati dummedho kuṭaṃ bhinno va dhuttako ti
